The plan requires: All three are importable from markdown.extensions.toc. """ from markdown.extensions.toc import striptags, render_inner_html, run_postprocessors assert callable(striptags) assert callable(render_inner_html) assert callable(run_postprocessors) def test_striptags_preserves_entities(): """Test that striptags strips tags but does NOT unescape HTML entities. The plan requires: striptags must convert an HTML string to plain text without unescaping HTML entities (unlike markupsafe's implementation). """ from markdown.extensions.toc import striptags result = striptags("

Hello & world

") # Entities should be preserved, not unescaped assert "&" in result, f"Entities should be preserved, got: {result!r}" assert result == "Hello & world", f"Expected 'Hello & world', got: {result!r}" def test_striptags_removes_tags(): """Test that striptags removes HTML tags and returns plain text.""" from markdown.extensions.toc import striptags result = striptags("Bold and strong") assert "<" not in result, f"Should contain no HTML tags, got: {result!r}" assert "Bold" in result assert "strong" in result def test_run_postprocessors_applies_processors(): """Test that run_postprocessors runs md.postprocessors on text. The plan requires: run_postprocessors(text, md) returns the text after all md.postprocessors have been applied. """ import markdown from markdown.extensions.toc import run_postprocessors md = markdown.Markdown() # Apply postprocessors to some text result = run_postprocessors("some text", md) assert isinstance(result, str) # The result should be processed through postprocessors # Postprocessors like HtmlSubstitute may modify the text def test_render_inner_html_returns_serialized_children(): """Test that render_inner_html returns the serialized inner HTML of an element. """ import markdown from markdown.extensions.toc import render_inner_html import xml.etree.ElementTree as etree md = markdown.Markdown() # Create a simple element tree parent = etree.Element("div") child = etree.SubElement(parent, "span") child.text = "Hello" result = render_inner_html(md, parent) assert isinstance(result, str) assert len(result) > 0 # Should contain the serialized children assert "Hello" in result ''' with open('crucible_hidden/test_m1.py', 'w') as f: f.write(test_m1) print("test_m1.py rewritten with 5 tests")
